props.name: children
props.description: The chart's parts. Root never inspects them. The plot is one tab stop. Hover a slice, or focus the chart and use the arrow keys, to make it active. The active slice moves out along its bisector by `--chart-slice-pop`, 8 px by default, and the others dim. A pointer anywhere in the chart's cell picks the slice under its angle, the hole and the space past the rim included. On a touch screen a drag that starts on the dial scrubs round it, a tap pins the tooltip, and a second tap on the same slice releases it.

props.description: One entry per category, keyed by category value. Each entry is a `ChartSeriesConfig` with `label`, `color` and optionally `format` and `icon`. props.name: data
props.description: The rows, one per slice, drawn in data order from `startAngle`, clockwise. Sort the rows to put the largest slice first. A negative value throws `negative-polar-value`. A data update tweens the slices to their new angles, and a slice that leaves collapses into its neighbour's seam. Every value above 0 keeps at least one device pixel of rim, and the labels, the tooltip and the table keep the true value. With no value above 0 the chart shows `Empty` and has no tab stop. A server component can render the chart when every prop is plain data, and with JavaScript off or in print the whole chart shows at once.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles, with every public chart custom property typed. `--chart-hover-dim` is the opacity of the marks outside the active slot or slice, 0.45 by default, and 1 turns the dim off. Dot rings, seams and label halos paint `--surface`, the opaque fill the chart rests on, and the muted text on them reads `--surface-muted-foreground`. Fuse's opaque containers, such as Card, Frame.Panel, Alert, Dialog and Popover, set both, and the page's `--background` is the fallback. On a fill of your own, set both beside it, such as `{ background: "var(--muted)", "--surface": "var(--muted)", "--surface-muted-foreground": "var(--muted-foreground)" }`. A translucent tint keeps the surface beneath it, and an image or a gradient has no colour for the cut-outs to match.

props.name: anchor
props.description: Where the popup rests on a vertical chart. "point" centres it on the active slot, inside the chart's box and then the viewport, and rests it 8 px above the highest mark under its own width: a bar, a stack top, a line or area stroke between readings, or a dot. A step to a taller neighbour lifts it over every mark on the way, and a step that would lower it by 16 px or less keeps its height. "top" pins it to the plot top and tracks x only, as a chart with Panels always does. A horizontal chart places it over or under the active row either way. A step to another slot glides the popup there over `--chart-glide`, 924 ms on a spring that never overshoots. It moves at once when it opens, flips side, or follows a scroll, a resize or a data update, when its path would leave the viewport, and under reduced motion. The popup stays open while the pointer moves onto it, and Escape closes it. A touch lift pins it, and a second tap dismisses it.
